quarterly_data.quarter: Eversource press release: ISO New England selects Eversource's joint transmission (09-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: ISO New England selected Eversource's joint Transmission Initiative Down East (TIDE) project as the preferred longer-term transmission solution in its competitive transmission solicitation (following the earlier preliminary selection). TIDE expands transmission capacity between Maine and New Hampshire and would allow up to 1,200 megawatts of future onshore wind generation in northern New England to integrate into the regional grid. Eversource's portion is mainly upgrades within existing New Hampshire rights-of-way, with additional work in Maine and Massachusetts: a new 18-mile, 345 kilovolt (kV) line, a rebuild of one existing 345 kV line, reconductoring of another, and voltage/power-quality equipment. Construction is anticipated to begin in 2029, pending all state and regulatory approvals and after engineering, environmental and permitting reviews. No project cost stated in the release.
